description: Update an existing holiday profile in your organization (name, holiday list, default-for-countries, active flag, or notes). The organization is fixed by your context. A profile's year cannot be changed. Only the fields you supply are changed; supplying holidays REPLACES the profile's holiday list. Holiday dates must fall within the profile's year.

default_for_countries.description: Optional comma-separated ISO-2 country codes this profile is the default for, e.g. "US,CA".

holidays.description: A JSON array (as a string) that REPLACES the profile's holidays, each: {"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","name":"...","full_day_off":true|false,"window_start":"HH:mm","window_end":"HH:mm"}. Dates must be within the profile's year.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

profile_id.description: Id of the holiday profile to update (required). Must belong to your organization.

name: update_holiday_profile
